notes.title: Lantern of Worlds will be free to play.
notes.notes:
Hello!

Lantern of Worlds will be going free to play soon. The game is getting a bit old, and is not really representative anymore of the quality I would like to see in my games. Also, there have been reported some technical difficulties, thought the game seems to run fine for most.

Anyway, I would not feel right about charging for the game anymore, so I have decided to make it free to play. It is still a game dear to me, and I would not like to remove it entirely.

My thanks to anyone who bought the game! And there will be more games coming in the future!

Best regards,

Fabian Schurgers

notes.title: Update 1.4 is now live!
notes.notes:
I am very happy to announce that the 1.4 update of Lantern of Worlds is now live!

The most important change is that the game has been remade in a newer version of the engine, increasing smoothness and general stability.

Further changes of this update include:

- Wildlife! Birds and small animals are now present at the tournament!

- A new tournament map, hand painted by Ponylab!

-Fishing! You can now do some sea fishing  on the beaches of the great desert. Who knows what you might catch!

- A new font, the Papyrus font has been replaced.

- A new story, of a shipwreck and a ghostly carpenter.

- And many small tweaks and improvements!

notes.title: First DLC available now!
notes.notes:
The story of king Valdemar is available now!

The story of king Valdemar is an 11 page PDF booklet, that tells the story of how king Valdemar rose to the throne of Idunia. Learn of his battles, his victories, and his losses, as he becomes the ruler and protector of Iduna, and the leader of the Royal Adventurers!

The story is the first of many, that will accompany each new game in the Lantern of Worlds series, and will shed light on the histories of the mayor characters the player will meet.

The PDF is available from your SteamApps\Lantern of Worlds game directory.
